'''Vendikar Station''' was a space station presumably near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vien'sai'Malloc]] and "[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Tuulaa Doneeta]]" met on the station in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
